The explicit history-dependent unnormalized survival/product-integration proof is attributed ASTIS completion; conditional density/iteration/full(A.7) remain open.
Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix any deterministic y,r∈E and initial phase z₀∈E×E. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. For every deterministic n≥0 let H_n(w)=(R_j(ε(w)))_(0≤j≤n)∈Hist_n=D^(Fin(n+1)), and let μ_n=(H_n)_*P. Thus the last record R_n consumes only raw clocks k<n, and w_n is the next unused clock. Take any Borel function d:Hist_n→[0,∞); each d(h) is finite but the function need not be bounded. Define L(r,u,e) to mean u<τ_z(max(e,0)) when r=live(T,z), and false when r=stopped. Live histories whose next wait is infinite survive every finite d(h); stopped histories have zero weight and no fictitious phase or wait in the statement. The case n=0, null events, zero rates and dimension zero are included. Borel d and A specify admissible deterministic tests rather than additional analytic hypotheses.             (d (history y xRef z₀ n w)) (w n)} =

    ∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ n : ℕ,

        liveSurvival y xRef (p.1 ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩) (d p.1) (p.2 0)} ∧
      Measurable (fun h : Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) =>
        survivalWeight y xRef (h ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩) (d h)) ∧

      (∀ A : Set (Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit)), MeasurableSet A →
        P {w : ℕ → ℝ | history y xRef z₀ n w ∈ A ∧

            (d (history y xRef z₀ n w)) (w n)} =

/-- Conditional next-wait survival for the actual finite stopped history.
The duration is a Borel function of that entire history. No normalization or
strict positivity of the history event is required. -/
theorem actual_conditional_next_wait_survival
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    actual_conditional_next_wait_survival_statement hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη := by
  classical
  let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
  let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
    (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
        (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
     (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
  let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
    (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
      ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
  let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
    Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
  let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
    ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
  let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
    MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
      (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
        Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
      (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
  let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
      ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
    match r with
    | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
    | Sum.inl a =>
      if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
        Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
          S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
  let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
      ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
    Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
  let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
  let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun w k => Real.toNNReal (w k)
  let history : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (ℕ → ℝ) →
      (Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit)) :=
    fun y xRef z₀ n w j => record y xRef z₀ (ε w) j.val
  let liveSurvival : E → E → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ → Prop :=
    fun y xRef r u e => match r with
      | Sum.inl a => (u : WithTop ℝ≥0) < τ y xRef a.2 (Real.toNNReal e)
      | Sum.inr _ => False
  let survivalWeight : E → E → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ≥0∞ :=
    fun y xRef r u => match r with
      | Sum.inl a => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Λ y xRef a.2 u))
      | Sum.inr _ => 0
  change
  ∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ n : ℕ,
    ∀ d : (Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit)) → ℝ≥0,
    Measurable d →
    MeasurableSet {p : (Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit)) × (ℕ → ℝ) |
      liveSurvival y xRef (p.1 ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩) (d p.1) (p.2 0)} ∧
    Measurable (fun h : Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) =>
      survivalWeight y xRef (h ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩) (d h)) ∧
    (∀ h : Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit),
      survivalWeight y xRef (h ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩) (d h) ≤ 1) ∧
    (∀ A : Set (Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit)), MeasurableSet A →
      P {w : ℕ → ℝ | history y xRef z₀ n w ∈ A ∧
        liveSurvival y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n)
          (d (history y xRef z₀ n w)) (w n)} =
      ∫⁻ h in A, survivalWeight y xRef (h ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩) (d h)
        ∂(Measure.map (history y xRef z₀ n) P))

  have hh := ActualHazardClock.actual_integrated_hazard_clock_laws hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  rcases hh with ⟨hΛc, hΛm, hInt, hΛpos, hcross, hfinite, hτm, hSurv, hcap, hfloor⟩
  have hτtyped : Measurable (fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
      τ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 a.2.2) := hτm
  have hΛtyped : Measurable (fun a : ((E × E) × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 =>
      Λ a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 a.2) := hΛm
  have hi := AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.UnitExponentialProduct.unit_exponential_product_laws
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure P := hi.1
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (expMeasure (1 : ℝ)) :=
    isProbabilityMeasure_expMeasure zero_lt_one
  intro y xRef z₀ n d hd
  let D := ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit)
  let Hist := Fin (n + 1) → D
  let last : Fin (n + 1) := ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩
  let H : (ℕ → ℝ) → Hist := history y xRef z₀ n
  let Y : (ℕ → ℝ) → (ℕ → ℝ) := fun w k => w (n + k)
  have hp := ActualFiniteHistoryTailLaw.actual_finite_history_tail_law
    hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη y xRef z₀ n
  have hH : Measurable H := hp.1
  have hY : Measurable Y := hp.2.1
  have hjoint : Measure.map (fun w => (H w, Y w)) P =
      (Measure.map H P).prod P := hp.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  -- A stopped record has no next wait. The following zero-valued observable
  -- is only used under a strict nonnegative-duration comparison, hence false.
  let waitObs : D × ℝ → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun q => match q.1 with
    | Sum.inl a => τ y xRef a.2 (Real.toNNReal q.2)
    | Sum.inr _ => 0
  have hwait : Measurable waitObs := by
    let e := MeasurableEquiv.sumProdDistrib (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) Unit ℝ
    have hl : Measurable (fun q : (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) × ℝ =>
        τ y xRef q.1.2 (Real.toNNReal q.2)) :=
      hτtyped.comp (f := fun q : (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) × ℝ =>
        ((y, xRef), q.1.2, Real.toNNReal q.2))
        ((measurable_const : Measurable (fun _ : (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) × ℝ =>
        (y, xRef))).prodMk (measurable_fst.snd.prodMk
          (measurable_real_toNNReal.comp measurable_snd)))
    have heq : waitObs = (Sum.elim
        (fun q : (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) × ℝ => τ y xRef q.1.2 (Real.toNNReal q.2))
        (fun _ : Unit × ℝ => (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0))) ∘ e := by
      funext q
      rcases q with ⟨a | a, t⟩ <;> rfl
    rw [heq]
    exact (hl.sumElim (measurable_const : Measurable (fun _ : Unit × ℝ =>
      (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0)))).comp e.measurable
  have hwaitEq (r : D) (u : ℝ≥0) (e : ℝ) :
      liveSurvival y xRef r u e ↔ (u : WithTop ℝ≥0) < waitObs (r, e) := by
    cases r with
    | inl a => rfl
    | inr a =>
      simp only [liveSurvival, waitObs, false_iff]
      exact not_lt.mpr (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr (show (0 : ℝ≥0) ≤ u from zero_le))
  let B : Set (Hist × (ℕ → ℝ)) := {p |
    liveSurvival y xRef (p.1 last) (d p.1) (p.2 0)}
  have hB : MeasurableSet B := by
    have hm := measurableSet_lt (WithTop.measurable_coe.comp (hd.comp measurable_fst))
      (hwait.comp (f := fun p : Hist × (ℕ → ℝ) => (p.1 last, p.2 0))
        (((measurable_pi_apply last).comp measurable_fst).prodMk
        ((measurable_pi_apply 0).comp measurable_snd)))
    simpa only [B, hwaitEq, Function.comp_def] using hm
  -- Joint Borel hazard gives a Borel exponential weight, including dead records.
  let weightObs : D × ℝ≥0 → ℝ≥0∞ := fun q => match q.1 with
    | Sum.inl a => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Λ y xRef a.2 q.2))
    | Sum.inr _ => 0
  have hweightObs : Measurable weightObs := by
    let e := MeasurableEquiv.sumProdDistrib (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) Unit ℝ≥0
    have hl : Measurable (fun q : (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 =>
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Λ y xRef q.1.2 q.2))) := by
      exact (hΛtyped.comp (f := fun q : (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 =>
        (((y, xRef), q.1.2), q.2)) (((measurable_const : Measurable
        (fun _ : (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 => (y, xRef))).prodMk
          measurable_fst.snd).prodMk measurable_snd)).neg.exp.ennreal_ofReal
    have heq : weightObs = (Sum.elim
        (fun q : (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 =>
          ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Λ y xRef q.1.2 q.2)))
        (fun _ : Unit × ℝ≥0 => (0 : ℝ≥0∞))) ∘ e := by
      funext q
      rcases q with ⟨a | a, t⟩ <;> rfl
    rw [heq]
    exact (hl.sumElim (measurable_const : Measurable
      (fun _ : Unit × ℝ≥0 => (0 : ℝ≥0∞)))).comp e.measurable
  let weight : Hist → ℝ≥0∞ := fun h => survivalWeight y xRef (h last) (d h)
  have hw : Measurable weight :=
    hweightObs.comp ((measurable_pi_apply last).prodMk hd)
  have hbound (h : Hist) : weight h ≤ 1 := by
    change survivalWeight y xRef (h last) (d h) ≤ 1
    cases h last with
    | inr a => simp [survivalWeight]
    | inl a =>
      change ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Λ y xRef a.2 (d h))) ≤ 1
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_one.mpr
        (Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (neg_nonpos.mpr ((hΛpos y xRef a.2).2.1 (d h))))
  -- For every fixed live history, integrate only its independent next clock.
  have hfiber (h : Hist) : P {w : ℕ → ℝ |
      liveSurvival y xRef (h last) (d h) (w 0)} = weight h := by
    cases hr : h last with
    | inr a => simp [liveSurvival, weight, survivalWeight, hr]
    | inl a =>
      let z := a.2
      let f : ℝ → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun e => τ y xRef z (Real.toNNReal e)
      have hf : Measurable f := hτtyped.comp (f := fun e : ℝ =>
        ((y, xRef), z, Real.toNNReal e))
        ((measurable_const : Measurable (fun _ : ℝ => (y, xRef))).prodMk
          ((measurable_const : Measurable (fun _ : ℝ => z)).prodMk
            measurable_real_toNNReal))
      have hs := hSurv y xRef z
      letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map f (expMeasure (1 : ℝ))) := hs.1
      have ht : Measure.map f (expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
          (Set.Ioi ((d h : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0)) =
          ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z (d h))) := by
        rw [← ofReal_measureReal, hs.2 (d h)]
      calc
        P {w : ℕ → ℝ | liveSurvival y xRef (Sum.inl a) (d h) (w 0)} =
            (Measure.map (fun w : ℕ → ℝ => w 0) P)
              (f ⁻¹' Set.Ioi ((d h : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0)) := by
          rw [Measure.map_apply (measurable_pi_apply 0)
            (measurableSet_Ioi.preimage hf)]
          simp only [liveSurvival, hr, f, z]
          rfl
        _ = (expMeasure (1 : ℝ)) (f ⁻¹' Set.Ioi ((d h : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0)) := by
          rw [(hi.2.1 0).2.2]
        _ = Measure.map f (expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
            (Set.Ioi ((d h : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0)) :=
          (Measure.map_apply hf measurableSet_Ioi).symm
        _ = weight h := by simpa only [weight, survivalWeight, hr, z] using ht
  refine ⟨hB, hw, hbound, ?_⟩
  intro A hA
  let C : Set (Hist × (ℕ → ℝ)) := {p | p.1 ∈ A ∧ p ∈ B}
  have hC : MeasurableSet C := (hA.preimage measurable_fst).inter hB
  calc
    P {w : ℕ → ℝ | H w ∈ A ∧ liveSurvival y xRef
        (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n) (d (H w)) (w n)} =
        (Measure.map (fun w => (H w, Y w)) P) C := by
      rw [Measure.map_apply (hH.prodMk hY) hC]
      rfl
    _ = ((Measure.map H P).prod P) C := by rw [hjoint]
    _ = ∫⁻ h : Hist, P {w : ℕ → ℝ | (h, w) ∈ C} ∂Measure.map H P :=
      Measure.prod_apply hC
    _ = ∫⁻ h : Hist, A.indicator weight h ∂Measure.map H P := by
      apply lintegral_congr
      intro h
      by_cases ha : h ∈ A
      · simpa only [C, B, Set.mem_setOf_eq, ha, true_and,
          Set.indicator_of_mem ha] using hfiber h
      · simp only [C, Set.mem_setOf_eq, ha, false_and, Set.setOf_false,
          measure_empty, Set.indicator_of_notMem ha]
    _ = ∫⁻ h in A, survivalWeight y xRef (h last) (d h) ∂Measure.map H P :=
      lintegral_indicator hA weight

end

Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix any deterministic y,r∈E and initial phase z₀∈E×E. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. For every deterministic n≥0 let H_n(w)=(R_j(ε(w)))_(0≤j≤n)∈Hist_n=D^(Fin(n+1)), and let μ_n=(H_n)_*P. Thus the last record R_n consumes only raw clocks k<n, and w_n is the next unused clock. Define q(r,u)=exp(−Λ_z(u)) when r=live(T,z), and zero when r=stopped. The event B_d={(h,v)∈Hist_n×ℝ^ℕ:L(h_n,d(h),v_0)} is Borel. lesson.statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix any deterministic y,r∈E and initial phase z₀∈E×E. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. For every deterministic n≥0 let H_n(w)=(R_j(ε(w)))_(0≤j≤n)∈Hist_n=D^(Fin(n+1)), and let μ_n=(H_n)_*P. Thus the last record R_n consumes only raw clocks k<n, and w_n is the next unused clock. Take any Borel function d:Hist_n→[0,∞); each d(h) is finite but the function need not be bounded. Define L(r,u,e) to mean u<τ_z(max(e,0)) when r=live(T,z), and false when r=stopped. Define q(r,u)=exp(−Λ_z(u)) when r=live(T,z), and zero when r=stopped. The event B_d={(h,v)∈Hist_n×ℝ^ℕ:L(h_n,d(h),v_0)} is Borel. The weight q_d(h)=q(h_n,d(h)) is Borel and 0≤q_d(h)≤1 for every history h. For every Borel A⊆Hist_n, P{w:H_n(w)∈A and L(R_n(ε(w)),d(H_n(w)),w_n)}=∫_A q_d(h) μ_n(dh). All conclusions hold for every deterministic y,r,z₀,n and admissible d,A under the same six standing analytic hypotheses. No positivity of μ_n(A), boundedness of d, finite-wait assumption or extra regularity/independence/conditional-law provider is required. Live histories whose next wait is infinite survive every finite d(h); stopped histories have zero weight and no fictitious phase or wait in the statement. The case n=0, null events, zero rates and dimension zero are included. Borel d and A specify admissible deterministic tests rather than additional analytic hypotheses. steps.title: Derive the joint survival event measurability
steps.text: Distribute the Borel record sum across the raw clock coordinate. On live records the wait observable is the composition of the joint Borel τ with the phase projection and e↦max(e,0); on the stopped summand use the zero observable solely for this proof. Since u≥0, u<0 is false, so this auxiliary observable gives exactly L, never a new stopped phase or algorithm transition. Compose with the Borel last-history projection, d and tail coordinate0. Strict comparison in [0,∞] is Borel, proving B_d is Borel.

    | Sum.inl a => τ y xRef a.2 (Real.toNNReal q.2)
    | Sum.inr _ => 0
  have hwait : Measurable waitObs := by
    let e := MeasurableEquiv.sumProdDistrib (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) Unit ℝ
    have hl : Measurable (fun q : (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) × ℝ =>
        τ y xRef q.1.2 (Real.toNNReal q.2)) :=
      hτtyped.comp (f := fun q : (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) × ℝ =>
        ((y, xRef), q.1.2, Real.toNNReal q.2))
        ((measurable_const : Measurable (fun _ : (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) × ℝ =>
        (y, xRef))).prodMk (measurable_fst.snd.prodMk
          (measurable_real_toNNReal.comp measurable_snd)))
    have heq : waitObs = (Sum.elim

steps.title: Evaluate each fixed-history survival fiber
steps.text: Fix a history h. For a stopped last record the fiber is empty and its P-measure is zero. For a live last record z, push raw coordinate0 forward under P to Exp(1), then push that law through e↦τ_z(max(e,0)). The existing hazard-clock theorem identifies the real probability of (d(h),∞] with exp(−Λ_z(d(h))). Its pushed law is a probability measure, so conversion to an extended nonnegative measure loses no mass. This is a pointwise identity for every fixed h and its d(h), not substitution into separate almost-everywhere statements indexed by fixed times.

Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. For every deterministic n≥0 let H_n(w)=(R_j(ε(w)))_(0≤j≤n)∈Hist_n=D^(Fin(n+1)), and let μ_n=(H_n)_*P. Thus the last record R_n consumes only raw clocks k<n, and w_n is the next unused clock. Take any Borel function d:Hist_n→[0,∞); each d(h) is finite but the function need not be bounded. Define L(r,u,e) to mean u<τ_z(max(e,0)) when r=live(T,z), and false when r=stopped. Define q(r,u)=exp(−Λ_z(u)) when r=live(T,z), and zero when r=stopped. The event B_d={(h,v)∈Hist_n×ℝ^ℕ:L(h_n,d(h),v_0)} is Borel. The weight q_d(h)=q(h_n,d(h)) is Borel and 0≤q_d(h)≤1 for every history h. For every Borel A⊆Hist_n, P{w:H_n(w)∈A and L(R_n(ε(w)),d(H_n(w)),w_n)}=∫_A q_d(h) μ_n(dh). All conclusions hold for every deterministic y,r,z₀,n and admissible d,A under the same six standing analytic hypotheses. No positivity of μ_n(A), boundedness of d, finite-wait assumption or extra regularity/independence/conditional-law provider is required. Live histories whose next wait is infinite survive every finite d(h); stopped histories have zero weight and no fictitious phase or wait in the statement. The case n=0, null events, zero rates and dimension zero are included. Borel d and A specify admissible deterministic tests rather than additional analytic hypotheses. This is an attributed ASTIS completion of the history-dependent conditional survival ingredient implicit in AppendixA.1(A.7), using the actual recursion. Conditional finite-wait densities, ordered-time disintegration and iteration, final path factor assembly, full(A.7), physical-time residual memorylessness, random stopping/restart/Markovness, reversal, invariance, all-L² contraction, implementation error/cost, main results and actual-input composition remain separate obligations.
